item.title: Seattle Kraken returning to action seeking to join postseason party
item.description: The Kraken return to play this week after the NHL's Winter Olympics break looking to join the Mariners and Seahawks by making a run to the playoffs.

item.title: $130,000 in designer purses, jewelry stolen in Seattle burglary
item.description: Police are investigating after a Queen Anne home was burglarized, with high-end purses, jewelry and other luxury items stolen.

item.title: Everett CEO says Trump tariff turmoil strains international competition
item.description: Businesses all over western Washington are trying to navigate tariffs. For some, it means raising prices for customers while others are trying to find ways to absorb the cost.

item.title: New report shows more Latinos without criminal histories being detained under Trump
item.description: A new UCLA report found that ICE detentions of Latinos without criminal histories have sharply increased under President Trump.

item.title: Man accused of unlawful gun possession after Thurston County, WA chase
item.description: A Thurston County man with prior felony convictions is facing a federal firearms charge after deputies say they recovered two “ghost guns" following a pursuit and crash near Rochester.

item.title: Lawmakers flag nearly 2,000 duplicate records in millionaires tax public sign-ins
item.description: Washington lawmakers say more than 1,900 duplicate records and hundreds of potentially fraudulent sign-ins were found in public testimony on a proposed millionaires tax bill, as debate continues in Olympia.

item.title: Seattle Kraken reach two-year extensions with Ben Meyers, Ryan Winterton
item.description: The Seattle Kraken have reached two-year contract extensions with forwards Ben Meyers and Ryan Winterton, the team announced on Tuesday.

item.title: Fan zone locations across WA revealed for 2026 FIFA World Cup
item.description: Official 2026 FIFA World Cup fan zones will open in nine Washington cities, offering free celebrations throughout the tournament.

item.title: Bellevue, WA identity theft suspect pleads not guilty
item.description: A man suspected of car prowling and identity theft is now facing a new burglary charge, and a judge kept his $10,000 bail in place.

item.title: Homicide investigation underway at Auburn, WA condo complex
item.description: A person was found dead Tuesday afternoon at a condo complex in Auburn, prompting a homicide investigation.
